title: Grilled Shungiku Skewers with Brazilian Salsa
description: A simple and flavorful recipe featuring shungiku greens grilled to perfection and served with a zesty Brazilian-inspired salsa.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
3. Add chopped shungiku and sliced yellow spring onions to the bowl, toss to coat.
4. Thread shungiku and onion mixture onto skewers.
5. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
6. Meanwhile, prepare the Brazilian salsa by mixing diced hot peppers with salt and black pepper.
7. Serve skewers hot with the Brazilian salsa on the side.
